title: Challenging beautiful and fun
text: Sandra was an amazing guide.  The hike was challenging enough to capture the interest of my 20 year old son, but reasonable enough for those in their 40s and 50s to find it fun.  Sandra had great stories to share and even brought hiking poles to make the descent a bit easier.  5 stars!

title: Best way to get explore Montserrat
text: An amazing experience! Our friendly and knowledgeable guide connected well with everyone and showed genuine care for the group’s well-being, making the tour both enjoyable and memorable.

title: Great hiking tour near Barcelona
text: We had a great hike with Bernat! He was an exceptional leader being sure everyone was safe and had a good experience. We also enjoyed learning so much about Catalan culture and history and about Montserrat. Thanks!
author: Jan_H

title: Beautiful Tour of Montserrat Monastery & Mountain
text: Excellent tour!  Informative, active and explorative.  Bernat was an experienced and passionate tour guide.  He was extremely knowledgeable on the area, history, flora and fauna of Montserrat.  He made the tour so interesting and one I will not forget.  It was a small group (just 3 of us) and we asked so many questions (which he was eager and able to answer) that we went almost an hour over on time. He kept asking to make sure no one was in a hurry, but was happy to extend the time since no one was anxious to finish the tour.  I was pleasantly surprised with the hike itself - it's a true hike.
author: Carrie_B

title: A highlight of our trip — hiking Montserrat with Sandra
text:
Our hike up Montserrat on November 5 was one of the highlights of our trip! Sandra was our tour guide, our driver, and our hiking expert. She knew so much about the history of the area and the monastery, and she had an easygoing sense of humor that made her wonderful company. She was kind and helpful throughout the hike.

Sandra planned the day beautifully and got the pace just right. We had plenty of time to stop along the trail, take photos, and enjoy the mountain views. We especially loved the small group. It felt like we were out for a hike with friends.

title: Amazing day trip from Barcelona.
text: I loved doing the Montserrat trail with Sandra. She was very knowledgeable and it was a fun and different experience. The place is beyond beautiful and the trail was medium difficulty, not so much because of the effort, but because of the hot weather, that can be challenging, so make sure to bring water.

title: An Unforgettable Montserrat Experience!
text: We recently took the English-speaking small group 6-hour trip to the Montserrat monastery and mountains, and it was the highlight of our trip! Our guide, Juan, was absolutely fantastic—knowledgeable, engaging, and attentive to everyone in the group. He shared fascinating history about the monastery and led us on a wonderful hike that offered breathtaking views. Everything was well-organized, and Juan made sure we had plenty of time to take in the beauty of the surroundings while keeping a comfortable pace. title: Awesome Hike
text: This is definitely a must-do hike. The views are awesome and our guide was great. I’m 31 years old and in good shape, and didn’t have any issues with the hike, but my 62 year old dad that’s in decent shape was struggling a bit as it is a pretty steep climb, just as a heads up. It was super cool though and I would recommend to anyone visiting Barcelona. The Monastery was also beautiful.
